<# One finding, in full — the original template's finding layout: "Title
   (Severity)", score and vector, affected systems, description with its
   steps to reproduce and evidence, recommendations, references.  Expects `f`
   and the page-wide `counter`; `in_appendix` (optional) drops the headings
   one level.  The sub-headings are numbered like the original's
   (4.1.1 Affected system(s), 4.1.2 Description, 4.1.2.1 Steps to reproduce),
   and every evidence image is "Figure N: …" counted through the report —
   by _bluestick/fields.lua, in the order a reader meets them, because an
   author may place an image INSIDE a written section (an "evidence:" image
   reference in the Markdown), where Jinja never sees it.
   Under Evidence, the test results that confirmed the finding come first
   (partials/_confirmations.qmd), then the screenshots no section places:
   f.evidence holds only those, f.images every image marked "In report". #>
<% set h2 = "###" if (in_appendix is defined and in_appendix) else "##" %>
<% set h3 = h2 ~ "#" %>
<% set h4 = h3 ~ "#" %>
<< h2|safe >> << f.title >> (<< f.severity_label >>) {#finding-<< f.id >>}

| Reference | CVSS score | Vector | Status |
|:------------|:------------|:----------------------------------------|:----------------|
| << f.ref or "—" >> | << "%.1f"|format(f.cvss_score) if f.cvss_score is not none else "Not scored" >> | << f.cvss_vector or "—" >> | << f.status_note or "Confirmed" >> |

<< h3|safe >> Affected system(s)

<% if f.affected %>
<% with rows = f.affected %><% include "partials/_affected.qmd" %><% endwith %>
<% else %>
Not specific to a host.
<% endif %>

<#
  A contact's list prints a section only when there is something in it: the
  report prints a TODO for its author under an empty heading, and here the
  reader is not the author — a page of bare headings read as a broken
  document.  The nesting is the report's: Impact, Steps and Evidence sit
  under Description.
#>
<% set confirmations = f.get("confirmations") or [] %>
<% set has_evidence = confirmations or f.evidence %>
<% if f.description or f.impact or f.steps_to_reproduce or has_evidence %>
<< h3|safe >> Description
<< md(f, "description") >>
<% if f.impact %>
<< h4|safe >> Impact
<< md(f, "impact") >>
<% endif %>
<% if f.steps_to_reproduce %>
<< h4|safe >> Steps to reproduce
<< md(f, "steps_to_reproduce") >>
<% endif %>
<% if has_evidence %>
<< h4|safe >> Evidence / proof of concept
<% if confirmations %>
<% include "partials/_confirmations.qmd" %>
<% endif %>
<% for e in f.evidence %>
<< image(e) >>
<% endfor %>
<% endif %>
<% endif %>

<< h3|safe >> Recommendations
<% if f.recommendation %>
<< md(f, "recommendation") >>
<% else %>

No recommendation has been written for this finding yet. Ask the assessment team for it.

<% endif %>
<% if f.references %>
<< h3|safe >> References
<< md(f, "references") >>
<% endif %>

{{< pagebreak >}}
